hints.title: Powers of Two Decomposition
hints.text: Express n as a sum of powers of 2 using its binary representation. Collect these powers in ascending order.

hints.title: Small Exponent Range
hints.text: Since n <= 10^9, the number of powers of two in powers is at most 30.

hints.title: Product Calculation Modulo Prime
hints.text: For each query [left, right], directly multiply powers from index left to right modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Powers Range Product Implementation

complexity.notes: Array length is at most 30, making each query evaluate in constant 30 steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Large exponent multiplications without modulo arithmetic cause integer overflow.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes n into binary bit powers and computes range products modulo 10^9 + 7.
